interface.name: deck_widget_manager_v1
interface.description: Global interface for Deck widget management. Widgets bind to this interface to register themselves with the compositor.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the widget manager. Does not affect existing widget surfaces.

request.name: get_widget_surface
request.description: Create a deck_widget_surface_v1 for the given wl_surface. The instance_id must match the DECK_INSTANCE_ID environment variable and is used by the compositor to identify this widget for positioning. The surface must not already have a role.

interface.name: deck_widget_surface_v1
interface.description: Interface for a widget surface. Initial configuration (size, params, settings) is received via environment variables. This protocol handles runtime communication: settings updates, shutdown, and action requests. Widget readiness is detected when the first buffer is committed.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the widget surface role. The wl_surface remains valid.

request.name: request_action
request.description: Request the compositor to perform a system action (sound, LED). The payload is JSON-encoded action data.

event.name: setting
event.description: Sent when a system setting changes at runtime.

event.name: shutdown
event.description: Sent when the widget should shut down gracefully. Widget should clean up and exit.
